description: Preparation path for UPSC Civil Services Examination (Prelims, GS Paper I): 100 questions, 2 marks each, 200 marks total, negative marking of one-third (0.66 marks per wrong answer). Polity syllabus spans the Indian Constitution — making, preamble, fundamental rights, DPSP, union and state government. This course covers Polity from the official UPSC syllabus and NCERT Class 11 'Indian Constitution at Work', sequenced L1 (foundation) to L4 (exam mastery).
title: UPSC CSE — Polity
